title: 第二十一章 请尊重我男朋友第二十二章 门口的哈根达斯
content_zh:
郑玥顿时脸就红了，也紧张起来。
答案很明显，这只是自己的计策，用来刺激包浩的。
然而，郑玥现在是绝不可能把真实原因告诉陆原的。
不仅不会说真实原因，实际上，现在的郑玥，早已把包浩给抛到九霄云外去了。
是的，郑玥现在的脑海里只有四个字“假戏真做”。
本来郑玥以为是个真吊丝，谁曾想到竟然是顶级富二代，自己何不趁机勾搭？
别说给陆原当正牌女朋友了，就算是当妾，郑玥也乐意啊。
“那个，其实是，上一次在银行里，我对陆少不敬，回去之后我很是悔恨，觉得自己太势利了，是一个嫌贫爱富的女人。所以，我决定改正自己的错误行为，于是，我对于男朋友的标准也改变了，不再要求是有钱，而是老实就好，我又想，穷苦的男孩子应该会疼人，所以，就让表妹找一个贫穷老实的男生，我不再计较他有没有钱，只要两人过得好就行了。”
郑玥这女人，应变力也是一流的，迅速又编出了一个原因。
“真的？”陆原笑了笑，看着郑玥。
“陆少你一定要相信我，如有半句虚假，我郑玥宁愿天打雷劈一辈子都被人唾骂不得善终！”郑玥斩钉截铁的说道。
额，这句话怎么听着这么耳熟呢，陆原心里嘿嘿一笑，这句话今天上午，李梦瑶也说过的啊。
“好吧，我相信你。”陆原说道，“不过，你现在也知道了我的身份，恐怕我不适合你啊。”
郑玥哪里会放手啊，此时的郑玥，心里早已认定了陆原了，这种富二代，上次放走了自己后悔了好几天，现在遇到了，说什么都不能错过了。
郑玥决定，自己要像癞皮狗一样，死死的缠住陆原。
“陆少，求求你就配合我一次吧。现在有个叫包浩的人，一直在追求我，这个家伙，仗着自己是个公司的小头目，威风的不得了，对我威逼利诱的，虽然他有点钱，但是我现在对男朋友的要求不是钱，而是人品，包浩这个人嚣张跋扈，人品很差，我一点都不喜欢他，可是他却讨得了我爸妈的欢心，我爸妈一直催逼着我，所以不得已，我才让表妹给我介绍一个老实人好的男生。”
说到这里，郑玥甚至流下了几滴眼泪，“陆少，我知道自己配不上你，但是希望你能帮帮我，假扮我男朋友一段时间，只要让包浩知难而退就好。求求你了，陆少。”
说着，郑玥泪眼如花，看起来凄婉哀怨，本来这女人长得就挺漂亮的，现在也如同梨花带雨，看上去楚楚可怜。
“额，好吧。”
陆原心一软，就答应了。

“不过，我有个条件。”
“陆少，你尽管说。”郑玥见到陆原答应，心里此时大喜，只是表面上还做出淡定的样子。
“我的身份，你不能告诉白染。”
陆原想了想，说道。
“嗯！我答应你！”郑玥急忙重重的点点头。
其实，不用陆原说，郑玥也没打算把陆原的真实身份告诉表妹。
女人嘛，即使是亲如表姐妹，一旦涉及到男人，也许都有自己的小算盘了。
表妹真是个大傻子，这么久了都没有看出来陆少的真实身份。假如自己要是告诉了她，表妹对陆少动心了，主动追求陆少了，那对自己的威胁就大了啊！
毕竟表妹和陆少是一个社团的，接触的机会比自己大得多。
自己绝对不能告诉表妹，免得多出一个竞争对手！
当然了，尽管陆原只是假扮自己的男朋友。
但是郑玥知道，感情嘛，都是天长日久培养出来的，自己利用这个机会，对陆原潜移默化各种勾搭暗示，说不定陆少就被自己的甜言蜜语搞定了呢？
嘎嘎，陆少，老娘吃定你了！
两人说定了之后，自然不可能一起回座位上去。
等郑玥先走了一会儿，陆原这才洗了洗手，烘干，这才回到座位上。
“叫你去催一下菜，都去了这么久，真是没用！点的东西早就到了。”白染一见到陆原回来，立刻就不满的责难道。
其实白染也有自己的小心思。
那就是在表姐面前，表现表现自己。
就好像在说，表姐，看到了吗，我在学校里还是很牛的吧，对他们喝来喝去的，很威风吧。
“染染，注意你的语气。”

郑玥微微皱眉看了表妹一眼，然后露出微笑对陆原说道，“好了，快坐下来吃吧。”
三人吃饭的时候，白染还依然不闲着，一会命令陆原去拿黑胡椒瓶给她，一会儿让陆原去拿餐巾纸，总之，就是把陆原当奴仆使用。
这种事情白染也习惯了，毕竟在网球社，一直就让陆原捡球的。
陆原倒是也没说什么就照办了，只是郑玥一直在紧皱眉头，心说表妹你这是在玩火！你竟然敢这么对待一个顶级富二代！
“那个，今天既然是给你们双方介绍的，那你们两人的意思都怎么样的啊，表姐，你觉得陆原怎么样？”
content_en:
Zheng Yue immediately blushed and became nervous.
The answer is obvious. This is just his own strategy to stimulate Bao Hao.
However, it is absolutely impossible for Zheng Yue to tell Lu Yuan the real reason now.
Not only could he not tell the real reason, in fact, Zheng Yue had already forgotten Bao Hao.
Yes, there are only four words in Zheng Yue's mind right now: "Fake it for real."
Originally, Zheng Yue thought he was a real hooker, but who would have thought that he was actually a top second-generation rich man? Why not take the opportunity to hook up with him?
Let alone being Lu Yuan's official girlfriend, Zheng Yue would be happy to be a concubine.
"Well, actually, the last time I was in the bank, I was disrespectful to Mr. Lu. After I went back, I regretted it very much. I felt that I was too snobbish and a woman who disliked the poor and loved the rich. So, I decided to correct my wrong behavior, so I treated my boyfriend The standard has also changed. It no longer requires being rich, but just being honest. I also thought that poor boys should love others, so I asked my cousin to find a poor and honest boy. I no longer care about whether he has money, as long as the two of them live well. "
Zheng Yue, a woman with excellent adaptability, quickly made up another reason.
"Really?" Lu Yuan smiled and looked at Zheng Yue.
"Young Master Lu, you must believe me. If any of my words are false, I, Zheng Yue, would rather be struck by lightning and be reviled for the rest of my life!" Zheng Yue said firmly.
Um, why does this sentence sound so familiar? Lu Yuan chuckled inwardly. Li Mengyao also said this sentence this morning.
"Okay, I believe you." Lu Yuan said, "But now that you know my identity, I'm afraid I'm not suitable for you."
How could Zheng Yue let go? At this time, Zheng Yue had already identified Lu Yuan in his heart. This kind of rich second generation had regretted letting him go for several days last time. Now that he had met him, he couldn't miss it at all.
Zheng Yue decided that she would cling to Lu Yuan like a mangy dog.
"Master Lu, please cooperate with me just once. Now there is a man named Bao Hao who has been pursuing me. This guy, because he is a small boss of the company, is extremely powerful and intimidates me. Although he has some money, what I want from my boyfriend now is It’s not about money, it’s about character. Bao Hao is arrogant and domineering and has a very bad character. I don’t like him at all, but he pleases my parents. My parents keep pushing me, so I had no choice but to ask my cousin to introduce me to an honest and good boy.”
Speaking of this, Zheng Yue even shed a few tears, "Master Lu, I know I'm not worthy of you, but I hope you can help me and pretend to be my boyfriend for a while, as long as Bao Hao quits. Please, Master Lu."
As he said this, Zheng Yue's eyes were filled with tears, and she looked sad and sad. This woman was originally very beautiful, but now she looked pitiful like a pear blossom in the rain.
"Uh, okay."
Lu Yuan's heart softened and he agreed.
"However, I have a condition."
"Young Master Lu, just say it." Zheng Yue was overjoyed when she saw Lu Yuan agreeing, but she still looked calm on the surface.
"You can't tell Bai Ran my identity."
Lu Yuan thought for a while and said.
"Yes! I promise you!" Zheng Yue nodded hurriedly.
In fact, without Lu Yuan's advice, Zheng Yue had no intention of telling his cousin Lu Yuan's true identity.
Women, even if they are as close as cousins, may have their own little plans when it comes to men.
My cousin is really a big fool. It has been so long that she hasn’t figured out Mr. Lu’s true identity. If he told her that his cousin was attracted to Mr. Lu and took the initiative to pursue Mr. Lu, then the threat to him would be great!
After all, my cousin and Mr. Lu are in the same club, and the chances of contact are much greater than mine.
I must not tell my cousin, lest there be another competitor.Competing with rivals!
Of course, even though Lu Yuan was just pretending to be his boyfriend.
But Zheng Yue knew that relationships are cultivated over time. He took advantage of this opportunity to give Lu Yuan various hints of hooking up. Maybe Mr. Lu would be taken over by his sweet words?
Quack, Mr. Lu, I’ve got you covered!
After the two of them agreed, it was naturally impossible for them to go back to their seats together.
After Zheng Yue left for a while, Lu Yuan washed and dried his hands before returning to his seat.
"I asked you to order the food. It's useless after I've been here for so long! The things you ordered have arrived a long time ago." When Bai Ran saw Lu Yuan come back, he immediately complained with dissatisfaction.
In fact, Bai Ran also has his own little thoughts.
That is to express yourself in front of your cousin.
It's like saying, Cousin, have you seen it? I'm still very good at school. I drink to them, so I'm very impressive.
"Ranran, pay attention to your tone."
Zheng Yue frowned slightly and glanced at her cousin, then smiled and said to Lu Yuan, "Okay, sit down and eat."
While the three of them were eating, Bai Ran was still busy. One moment he ordered Lu Yuan to get her a black pepper bottle, and another moment he asked Lu Yuan to get napkins. In short, he was using Lu Yuan as a slave.
Bai Ran is used to this kind of thing. After all, in the tennis club, Lu Yuan has always been asked to pick up the ball.
Lu Yuan did as he was told without saying anything, but Zheng Yue kept frowning, thinking to himself, cousin, you are playing with fire! How dare you treat a top rich second generation like this!
"Well, since I'm introducing you both today, what do you two think? Cousin, what do you think of Lu Yuan?"
